context_abs: Background: This time series represents the yearly sales of a manufacturing company, measured in units. The historical data shows fluctuating sales with an overall increasing trend. Scenario: Suppose a new product line is introduced from 1990-12-31 12:00:00 to 1991-12-31 12:00:00, resulting in a significant increase in sales, approximately 30% higher than the previous year. This introduction is likely to attract new customers and increase brand loyalty, leading to sustained growth. The impact of this new product line is expected to be most pronounced in the year 1991, with sales expected to be around 40% higher than the average of the previous years.
